Lima langkah berurutan dijalankan flow-state engine; gerbang keras membuka approval_requests regulatory_filing 48 jam. Studio-tier only.
skills.description_en: Recurring compliance-cycle playbook — identify due obligations, gather filing inputs, prepare the draft, hard-gate filing approval through the approval queue, then deliver a submit-ready filing. Five sequential steps run by the flow-state engine; the hard-gate opens a 48-hour regulatory_filing approval_requests row. Studio-tier only.

skills.description_id: Playbook siklus produksi filing keuangan periode berjalan — intake periode, enumerasi kewajiban filing aktif lewat compliance-checker, pemilihan filing dan input customer, drafting per filing lewat finance-dispatch dengan loop di dalam satu langkah, ringkasan draft dengan NPWP terselubung, gerbang keras persetujuan per filing via approval queue, penyerahan dokumen siap submit, lalu pencatatan ke bd_decisions_log. Delapan langkah berurutan dijalankan flow-state engine; gerbang keras membuka approval_requests regulatory_filing 48 jam per filing — versi produksi dari compliance-cycle yang advisory. Studio-tier only.
skills.description_en: Production-side finance-filing cycle playbook — period intake, active-filing enumeration via compliance-checker, customer filing selection and input collection, per-filing drafting via finance-dispatch with a loop-inside-a-step, redacted draft summary, per-filing hard-gate approval through the approval queue, submit-ready document delivery, and bd_decisions_log recording. Eight sequential steps run by the flow-state engine; the hard-gate opens a 48-hour regulatory_filing approval_requests row per filing — the production counterpart to the advisory compliance-cycle playbook. Studio-tier only.

templates.description_id: 5-stage Indonesian-founder roadmap checklist — Idea → Setup → Identity → Build → Sell. Per-stage deliverables + decision points + BD v3 state-machine deliverable id mapping (Phase 5-2 update).
PT vs CV side-by-side — modal, biaya, pajak, kompleksitas, fit context (UMKM, scale-up, multi-shareholder).
OSS Risk-Based Approach checklist — KBLI, tingkat risiko, dokumen wajib, timeline approval.
Reference Indonesian compliance due dates — BPJS bulanan, SPT Tahunan, PPh 21/25/Final, OSS 90-day verification.
BPJS Kesehatan + Ketenagakerjaan (4 program: JHT, JKK, JKM, JP) registration steps, biaya, threshold per status (PT/CV/Perorangan). Phase 5-4.
Monthly + annual DJP tax cycle (PPh 21/23/25/Final UMKM, PPN, SPT Tahunan 1771/1770) + PKP threshold + decision PPh 25 vs Final UMKM 0.5%. Phase 5-4.
Rekening badan setup checklist — dokumen per bentuk badan, bank comparison (BCA/Mandiri/BNI/BRI/Jago/Permata) + multi-account strategy. Phase 5-4.
UU 27/2022 (PDP) basic compliance checklist — 3 tier (basic / platform-tier / sensitive-data tier), DPO appointment, breach response, vendor processor agreements. Phase 5-4.
